Short title, extent and commencement

ACT XI OF 2020
ACT XI OF 2020
SINDH EPIDEMIC DISEASES
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2020
An Act to amend the Sindh Epidemic
Diseases Act, 2014
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV,
15th July, 2020]
NO.
PAS/LEGIS-B-09/2020, dated 15.7.2020.---The Sindh Epidemic Diseases (Amendment:) Bill, 2020 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 15th June, 2020 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 07th July, 2020 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Sindh
Epidemic Diseases Act, 2014, in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is
hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Sindh Epidemic Diseases (Amendment) Act, 2020.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.

Definitions

2. Amendment
of section 3 of Sindh Act No. VIII of 2015.---In the Sindh Epidemic Diseases Act, 2014, hereinafter referred to as
the said Act, in section 3, in subsection (3), after the words "Deputy
Commissioner", the words "or Assistant Commissioner or any other
Officer" shall be inserted.

Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Sindh

It is
hereby enacted as follows:-
3. Substitution
of section 4 of Sindh Act No. VIII of 2015.---In the said Act, for section 4, the following shall be substituted:-
"4.
Penalty.---(1) Whoever contravenes or disobeys the orders passed by the
Government or the officers empowered or the regulations made under this Act,
without prejudice to any punishment to which he may be liable under any other law
for the time being in force, shall be punishable with on spot fine upto rupees
one million or attachment of movable, immovable, perishable property or both:
Provided
that the order of imposing the penalty shall be in writing containing reasons
for the issuance of the order thereof.
(2) The fine
prescribed under subsection (1) shall be recovered as arrears of land revenue
under the Sindh Land Revenue Act, 1967 (Act No.XVII of 1967)."
